feeds.title: Thrive Alliance Group
feeds.description: Thrive Alliance Group shares articles to help schools understand mental health's impact on education and provide the support students need here. Thrive Alliance Group was formed to make mental wellness a part of the climate and culture in school districts across the country. Our programs make schools stronger and transform the lives of students.

feeds.title: The Education Hub Blog » Mental Health
feeds.description: The Education Hub talks about mental health, wherein they publish articles regarding how to support a student through academic years, and how to encourage them and also prevent health issues. The Education Hub is a site for parents, pupils, education professionals, and the media that captures all you need to know about the education system. You'll find accessible, straightforward information on popular topics, Q&As, interviews, case studies, and more.

feeds.title: Communicating Psychological Science » Mental Health
feeds.description: Read articles associated with regards to mental health, feeling, reaching out to help, asking for guidance, relationships, and more. The purpose of this website is to promote the communication of psychological science to the public and the development of science communication abilities in undergraduate students. We hope that our work here will help you better understand the fascinating realm of psychology and inspire you to seek out more information.

feeds.title: Active Minds » Student Stories
feeds.description: Active Minds is here to change the conversation about mental health through students' stories. We are dedicated to saving lives and to building stronger families and communities. Through education, research, advocacy, and a focus on young adults ages 14-25, Active Minds is opening up the conversation about mental health and creating lasting change in the way mental health is talked about, cared for, and valued in the United States.

feeds.title: Student Behavior Blog » Mental Health
feeds.description: Read articles on Mental Health by the experts on the Student Behavior website. The SRI Student Behavior Research Team has created this site to provide the latest information about evidence-based approaches to support all students' positive behavior, mental health, and well-being. The blog posts focus on district-, school-, classroom-, and student-based interventions and impacts, including informal tips, interviews, and more.

feeds.title: Timely MD » Mental Health
feeds.description: Stay up to date with the latest Mental Health coverage from TimelyMD's blog. TimelyMD is the leading virtual health and well-being solution for higher education that offers a complete care solution for campus health. Including mental and emotional support, medical, counseling, psychiatry, health coaching, and care navigation, TimelyMD provides the 24/7, on-demand and scheduled care that students need to be well and thrive.

feeds.title: UVic Student Mental Health
feeds.description: The UVic Student Mental Health Blog is dedicated to promoting positive mental health and reducing stigma. Hear directly from UVic students sharing their personal stories and tips for maintaining wellness, and learn ways to increase your happiness and wellbeing and decrease your stress as you navigate life as a student!

feeds.title: Student Minds Blog
feeds.description: The Student Minds blog is the UK's one of the biggest blogs on student wellbeing and mental health, sharing student experiences of mental health difficulties. It is the UK's student mental health charity. We empower students and members of the university community to look after their own mental health, support others and create change.

feeds.title: Franciscan Children's Blog » Mental Health
feeds.description: News and insight from Franciscan about our philosophy of hope through healthcare and recent issues affecting children's wellness. Since 1949 Franciscan Children's has served children and adolescents with complex medical, mental health, and educational needs. It is our privilege to care for children who need our help and their spirit motivates and inspires us every day.

feeds.title: BetterMynd Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Cody Semrau. I founded BetterMynd in 2017 which is an impact startup that is inspired to improve the mental health of America's 21 million college students. BetterMynd serves over 50 college campuses across the country to supplement the mental health and wellbeing of more than a half million students, and we look forward to the opportunity to show you how we can support your student population as well!

feeds.title: Black Students Mental Health Blog
feeds.description: My name is Ronalds Busulwa (Mental Health Practitioner, Addictions Counsellor, Researcher, Mental Health Lecturer). In this blog, we have put together several resources which you may find useful to help you cope with the pressures of university life to flourish. Resources include mental health services, self-help tips, guides, tools, and activities to support and improve mental health.

feeds.title: Student Talk Campus » Student Mental Health
feeds.description: Student Talk Campus addresses the mental pressure on students in daily life. The blog also sheds light on the issues faced by them and what solutions or measures can be taken to overcome those problems. TalkCampus is specifically for students in recognition of the unique challenges they face and we've designed our service to ensure that universities and colleges can offer affordable protection and support for their entire student body round the clock.
